bullets.text: relearning a knot from a video. the knot is fine. the thumbs are the problem.
⚇ overcast and cold at okunoin. the duck carries a line about technique and goal. the lanterns stay lit either way.
clocks fell back on sunday. breakfast still happened at the old time, out of loyalty.
monday after halloween. one fun-size candy bar left on the desk, guarding it like a small dog.
